match.userMessage: One greyscale storyboard frame. Frozen in this action: Scarlett finds the subway card beneath the folded scarf, tears open the coral lipstick box, twists up the bullet, and presses it once to the back of her hand. Framing: medium wide, slightly above, Scarlett framed at the sink on the right third, hard sunlight slicing across white tile, scarf and coral lipstick box in the foreground. Placement only, not the pose: Scarlett stands hurriedly at the narrow sink in a black turtleneck and silver hoop earrings, searching among the scarf and bathroom counter items. Camera, as one or two arrows: truck, smooth. Characters: Scarlett, Woman, 27, A 27-year-old woman of average height, Black fitted turtleneck, black wool coat carried. The bodies are frozen in that action: if someone sits, they are seated; if someone reaches, the arm is extended. One figure per character. Drawn as a storyboard artist's animatic frame: confident pencil line with flat grey marker tones, three or four values, greyscale only even where the description names a colour. Clear silhouettes, the set blocked in with simple shapes. Camera travel is one or two arrows. A rough pre-production drawing: not a finished illustration, not a photo, not a 3D render. The drawing fills the whole image edge to edge: no border, no frame line, no paper margin, no grid of panels. No text, no titles, no subtitles, no watermarks, no letters, no words, no signs, no UI elements.
